notes: Rejected 2026-11-17 on his word, after it was the first pass's pick or runner-up: "I prefer larger ove rsmall, lots of space there". Place on the wall opposite side of wall of where the living room console is (in the kitchen is where I will put it)." Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-20); taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. The kitchen is not measured, so the walkway in front of the piece (F-30: 30" at least, 36" preferred; 42" where it faces the range, sink or fridge, the designer's standard) is unchecked until Andrew tapes from that wall to whatever faces it. Fit: 40" leaves 11" of the 51"; 20" deep; 36.5" tall, counter height. Solid wood throughout ("100% Wood", made in Thailand), a hardwood top, one drawer with a steel pull, two slatted shelves, a steel towel bar; on legs, no wheels (Amazon files it under Stationary Storage Islands), 38.2 lb, so it stays put on the marble and one adult can shift it.
